functions.name: openclaw_gateway
functions.title: OpenClaw Sovereign Gateway
functions.description: Check Creator Nexus hub telemetry, verify OPEG V1.0 PT-symmetric R_san receipts, or dispatch an OpenClaw agent task with optional workspace draft patching and GitHub repo sync.

action.description: Gateway operation to run: status, dispatch_task, opeg_verify, or absorb_all_continuity.

agent_id.description: OpenClaw specialist identifier (e.g. openclaw-alpha, openclaw-sigma, openclaw-forge).

directive.description: Task directive or mission instruction for dispatch_task.

append_to_draft.description: When true, appends the generated patch to the active workspace draft.

push_to_github.description: When true, commits the execution report and artifact to GitHub.

g.description: Coupling parameter g for OPEG PT-symmetric Hamiltonian verification.

gamma.description: Gain/loss parameter gamma for OPEG PT-symmetric Hamiltonian verification.

epsilon.description: Perturbation epsilon for Puiseux fractional 1/3 expansion.

functions.name: compile_ollama_model
functions.title: Compile VPS Ollama Model
functions.description: Compile and deploy a custom φ^75-Ternary, Affective, or OPEG-V1.0 Modelfile to the live VPS Ollama server.

name.description: Model tag name to create on VPS Ollama (e.g. fraymus-openclaw-v1).

baseModel.description: Base model name, defaults to llama3.2:3b-instruct-q8_0.

systemPrompt.description: Full SYSTEM prompt / cognitive law to embed into the compiled model.

functions.name: run_argon_evolution
functions.title: Run Argon Ouroboros Evolution
functions.description: Inspect or evolve the Argon Ouroboros-Gauntlet RSI genome, orbital memory, consciousness falsification suite, or daily RSA/RSI telemetry report.

action.description: Evolution or telemetry action to execute.

title.description: Memory node title when action is store_memory.

payload.description: Memory node content when action is store_memory.

functions.name: build_loosescrew_app
functions.title: Build or Push LooseScrew App
functions.description: Autonomously synthesize an interactive dark-mode web app / synth module in LooseScrew Studio or push an existing build to GitHub.

prompt.description: Directive describing the application or module to build.

target_url.description: Optional reference URL to reverse-engineer or integrate.

item_id.description: LooseScrewItem ID when evolving or pushing to GitHub.

title.description: App title when pushing to GitHub.

functions.name: plan_director_scenes
functions.title: Plan Visual Director Scenes
functions.description: Compile a narrated script into a verified nexus.scene_plan/1 timed visual card blueprint.

ai_disclosure.description: Ensure final scene includes AI disclosure.
